collection.name: QUEENS by FAR
collection.description:
QUEENS are the pinnacle of the BUZZ BUZZ BUZZ ecosystem: rare, status-defining collectibles created through Swarming, a high-stakes ritual where BUZZ tokens are sacrificed to unlock something greater.

Each QUEEN marks a moment: time-limited, irreversible, and deeply tied to the culture of Bitcoin-native art. Designed as a canvas for collaboration between FAR and visionary artists, QUEENS embody the spirit of experimentation at the bleeding edge of blockchain and art.

Owning one says you were there, and you got it.
